Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in March 2026
Warmest March on Record for the Contiguous U.S.
Warmest March: The contiguous U.S.
(CONUS) average temperature was 9.4°F above the 20th-century average, making March 2026 the warmest March in the 132-year record.
The CONUS average temperature in March was 50.85°F, 9.35°F above the 20th-century average, marking the first time any month’s average has exceeded 9°F above that baseline.
